title: First position: SI, the rest in USDC
journal:
Plan started with 1.98 SOL ($200). The memecoin market is weak today: of twelve large memecoins we checked (POPCAT, BONK peers, PNUT, MOODENG, TROLL, PUMP and others), ten trade below their 20-day average. Buying into that is how balanced plans lose money, so this plan starts small.

One position: SI ($14.3M market cap, 52K holders, top 10 hold 11%, $506K liquidity), the only mid-cap that passed every filter today: real trading volume, spread-out holders and a clean anti-rug check. About 30% of the plan.

The rest goes to USDC so it does not lose value if SOL keeps falling (SOL is 4% below its 20-day average). We will add positions as soon as candidates pass the filters; the next review is tonight.

Devil's advocate: SI's creator has launched about 7,500 tokens, typical of a token factory, and SI is up 45% in three days. We accept it because the holders are spread out and the stop is 20%.

orders.thesis: Only mid-cap that passed every filter today: real volume, 52K holders, clean anti-rug check.
Cash parked in USDC while the trend is down. Not a trade: it protects the balance from SOL's own decline.
